items.why: Global energy policy discussions do not directly impact the Dubai property market.

bullets: On Monday 9 November, Dubai recorded 801 sales worth AED 2.9bn, which is 11.7% above a typical weekday.
Off-plan sales made up 59.8% of the total volume.
The median price was AED 1,664 per sq ft, down 0.4% over 30 days and down 4.5% year-on-year.
Over the last 7 days, the busiest areas were JVC with 201 sales, Dubai South with 197, and Palm Deira with 155.
In October new rental contracts, a JVC 1-bedroom apartment had a median rent of AED 69,812 a year, up 1.2% on the month.
talking_points: Dubai forecasts 365,000 new homes by 2030 amid high occupancy, which is an important supply factor to consider.
The DWC Metro link enhances appeal for Dubai South property buyers, where we saw 197 sales over the last 7 days.
Nakheel has launched a massive new residential community for 50,000 residents, signaling new developer activity.

bullets: Gold prices rose to $4,055.73 following sharp losses, as Federal Reserve rate hike expectations weigh on mortgage costs and affordability.
Monday 9 November recorded 801 sales worth AED 2.9bn, which is 11.7% above a typical weekday.

The median price was AED 1,664 per sq ft, down 0.4% over 30 days and down 4.5% from last year.

talking_points: Gold prices have risen to $4,055.73 following sharp losses, which may shift mortgage costs and affordability for financed buyers.
